items.t: DOJ closes antitrust probe into NextEra’s $66.8 bln Dominion deal
items.sum: Investing.com-- The U.S. Department of Justice said on Thursday it had closed its antitrust investigation into Nextera Energy's (NYSE:NEE) $66.8 billion acquisition of Dominion Energy (NYSE:D) after the companies committed to safeguards addressing concerns over electricity prices in New England.

items.t: NextEra-Dominion merger hearings kick off with focus on scope
items.sum: The case is “simply not the one to litigate the cost of service [or] who's paying their fair share ... including the data centers,” said Joe Reid, an attorney representing NextEra and Dominion, in his opening remarks to the Virginia State Corporation Commission.

items.t: Virginia regulators start Dominion-NextEra merger hearing
items.sum: Virginia regulators began formal hearings Tuesday to decide whether to approve a $67 billion merger proposal between Dominion Energy and NextEra Energy that would create the world’s largest regulated electric utility. The State Corporation Commission, which regulates utilities in Virginia and is the state decision-maker on the proposal, is hearing the case this week. The process kicked off ...
